Getting There & Entry

How to Get There

Ravello has no local airport, so every guest connects through one of three gateway cities. Italy is part of the Schengen Area, so standard EU entry rules apply.

Recommended

Naples · NAP

Best flight selection and shortest transfer for most guests, about 1 to 1.5 hours to Ravello.

Closest

Salerno · QSR

Only ~40 minutes to Ravello, but limited regional/EU flight options, worth checking first.

Most connections

Rome · FCO

Italy's main hub, best for long-haul flights, plus a high-speed train onward (~1h10 to Naples).

Passport & Entry

What you need at the border.

Check your passport NOW to make sure your passport doesn't expire. If you don't have a valid passport apply for your passport NOW! It can take a while to get in!

Passport validity

Valid at least 3 months past your departure date from Italy — 6 months recommended.

Visa-free entry

US, UK, Canadian, and Australian citizens can enter visa-free for stays under 90 days.

ETIAS New · Late 2026

A quick online travel authorization begins rolling out for visa-exempt travelers later this year.

Other nationalities

Italy's visa-free list is broad but not universal, check requirements for your specific passport.

Our Story

Before Ravello.

A few watercolor moments from along the way, painted from photos we'll treasure forever.

Kate and Jhon met in Denver, Colorado, in February 2022, just days after Valentine's Day, when love was still in the air. It was an instant connection after the first date. The following two and half years in Denver were spent full of travel, meeting each other's families, and welcoming our first dog, Stella.

Last August, on the shore of Menaggio on Lake Como, Jhon got down on one knee, one of the most meaningful moments of our lives. The rest of the trip was spent celebrating our engagement surrounded by family and friends. We wanted our wedding to feel just like that day, so we're bringing everyone we love back to Italy to celebrate with us.

FAQ

Questions, answered

Can't find what you need? Reach out any time, see the footer for contact details. More information will be provided following formal invitations.

At Villa Eva, a private Liberty-style villa at the top of Ravello on Italy's Amalfi Coast, details are still being finalized.
May 25, 2027, at Villa Eva in Ravello. We're still finalizing exact ceremony and reception times and will post the full itinerary here as soon as it's ready.
Naples (NAP) is the best choice for most guests, widest flight selection, about an hour to Ravello. Salerno (QSR) is closer but has fewer routes; Rome (FCO) works well if you're connecting from farther away. See "Getting There" above for a full breakdown.
Most guests, including from the US, UK, Canada, and Australia, can enter Italy visa-free for stays under 90 days. Starting later in 2026, an online travel authorization called ETIAS will also be required for visa-exempt travelers. We'll share the link once applications open.
It should be valid for at least 3 months past your departure date from Italy (6 months recommended), with at least 2 blank pages. Worth checking now, since renewals can take a while.
Villa Eva doesn't offer on-site accommodation, but it's a short walk from several Ravello hotels, including Villa Maria and Hotel Giordano. We're finalizing a room block and will post names and rates soon.
While our wedding will be mostly adults, we know some of you may need to bring your little ones! If that's the case for your family, please reach out to us directly so we can accommodate you and get an accurate headcount.
Euros (€)! Cards are widely accepted, but it's smart to carry some cash for small restaurants and shops. Tipping isn't obligatory, rounding up for good service is appreciated but not required.
Comfortable walking shoes for cobblestones and hills, sun protection, a light layer for cooler evenings, and anything specific to our dress code (details coming with the full invitation).
Please reach out to us if you have food allergies or dietary restrictions and we can make the proper accommodations.
Reach out any time! See the contact details in the footer below or text us. We're happy to help with anything travel or wedding-related.
